guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for all properties in a list of ASE atoms objects including info and calculator results
guess_target_metadata: guess the shape type and extensiveness of target samples given atom lengths and sample arrays
target_extensive: check whether a property is extensive by analyzing per-atom normalized variation across samples
target_per_atom: determine whether target samples are per-atom properties by checking if the first dimension matches atom count
target_constant_shape: check whether all target samples have the same shape regardless of atom count
